titleEn: I'll Do It All for You

pages.text: Today they would build a wooden fence on the slope. Each friend took one post.
Leo quickly drove in his post. "I'll do it all for you." Then everyone would thank him.
Leo took Mei's post and drove it in. Mei started to reach for it, then stopped.
He drove in Soso's too, then Rudi's.
The fence was finished. The four had only stood there.
Leo looked around at the four. Nobody said thank you.
The four dusted their hands. Nobody looked at Leo.
Grandma Bear pulled out a post and gave it to Leo. "Do it for them, and you take their joy too."
Leo gave the post to Soso, then sat beside Soso and waited.
Soso drove the post all the way in. "Thank you, Leo."
